error.invalid_topic: Enter a valid MQTT subscription topic.

abort.already_configured: This topic pattern is already configured.

overlap_topic_patterns.title: Overlapping topic patterns
overlap_topic_patterns.description: This Telegraf MQTT entry's topic pattern "{own_topic}" overlaps with another entry "{other_entry_title}" whose pattern is "{other_topic}". The same MQTT messages will be processed by both entries, producing duplicate entities. Change one of the patterns so they cover distinct message streams.

invalid_persisted_option.title: Invalid Telegraf MQTT option(s)
invalid_persisted_option.description: The persisted value for {options} is invalid. The integration fell back to default values ({defaults}) so setup could complete. Open the integration's options dialog and correct the values, or remove and re-add the entry to reset the options to defaults.
